headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 18, 2026, the portfolio is showing a year-to-date return of 24.34%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which has returned 13.36%. This results in an average alpha of 10.98%, indicating that the portfolio is not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved a remarkable return of 47.94%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' has a return of 15.88%, which still maintains a positive trajectory relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests the portfolio is effectively navigating the current environment. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
